name: spellkave_suggest_next_action
label: Spellkave Suggest Next Action
description: Read a deterministic Spellkave suggestion or affordance summary from SDK state. Does not submit reducers.

entity_ref.description: EntityRef of the perceiver body to suggest for — not `Actor.actor_id` (the steering principal). Accepts a bare numeric entity id (`42`), `entity:42`, `item:42` (an item is still an entity row; same numeric id), or a manifest key suffix (`core/player`).
